proposed_results_paragraphs: Gene-level inspection placed the eight programs in a hematopoietic context (Figure 7B). P1 contained Hlf, Mecom and Procr, supporting an HSC-associated regulatory annotation [Komorowska2017; Yokomizo2019]. P8 combined Pbx1, Zeb2 and Runx1 with receptor, adhesion and cytoskeletal genes, including Tgfbr3, Ncam2 and Itga6 [Ficara2008; Goossens2011]. P4 contained the ATF4-associated stress-response genes Trib3, Asns and Ddit3; P7 combined glycolytic enzymes with Bnip3 and Egln3. P5 contained Cdk6 and Cd48 together with immune-associated genes, including Nkg7, Tespa1 and Fcer1g, rather than a coherent platelet-specific identity. P2 encompassed broad biosynthetic/metabolic machinery, whereas P3 and P6 separated mitotic from DNA-replication/repair-associated expression.

These molecular mixtures distinguished the early relatives of the MC3 and MC7 reference histories (Figure 7C). The largest observed difference was in the mixed CDK6/immune-associated program P5, with mean fractional usage of 3.6% in MC3 and 17.7% in MC7. The Cdk6/Cd48 content is compatible with a progenitor-activation context [Laurenti2015; Boles2011], without establishing mature immune identity. MC3 instead showed higher usage of P1 (21.6% versus 12.4%) and P8 (13.4% versus 5.0%). MC7 had higher stress-associated P4 (16.0% versus 10.9%) and glycolysis/hypoxia-associated P7 (14.7% versus 10.7%) usage, while the mitotic and replication-associated profiles were more similar.

Thus, metaclones connect distinct reference histories to overlapping early regulatory, activation-associated and metabolic programs. These retrospective descriptions do not establish functional stem-cell identity, a causal differentiation mechanism or prediction of mutation response. In particular, stress responses and glycolysis can support HSC maintenance, so neither is a unidirectional marker of differentiation [vanGalen2018; Takubo2013].
figure7b_selection_description: Three representative genes per program were selected for biological interpretability from the top 40 raw-loading or specificity ranks, independently of MC3–MC7 effect magnitude. They are not necessarily the three highest-ranking genes or exclusive to one program. All 16,000 gene weights, all ranks, and the complete pre-existing enrichment family remain available.
interval_definition: Existing pointwise 2.5th/97.5th percentiles of 2000 within-metaclone family resamples; fixed NMF and fixed partition. No new bootstrap, contrast test, or biological-replicate interval.
